methods.name: Pinnability
methods.description: Recommender model retrained from scratch twice per week

methods.name: TransAct
methods.description: Feature or model component integrated with Pinnability, increasing computational complexity by 65 times in floating point operations

methods.name: GPU serving
methods.description: GPU model inference used to serve Pinnability with TransAct at neutral latency and cost

methods.name: Fuse CUDA kernels
methods.description: Fuses operations as much as possible using deep learning compilers such as nvFuser and custom implementations.

methods.name: Custom consolidated embedding lookup module
methods.description: Merges raw ID to table index and table index to embedding lookup for multiple features into one lookup, leveraging cuCollections to support hash tables for raw IDs on GPUs.

methods.name: Combine memory copies
methods.description: Mitigates overhead from copying hundreds of feature tensors individually from CPU to GPU memory for every inference.

methods.name: CUDA Graphs
methods.description: Captures the model inference process as a static graph of operations instead of individually scheduled ones, allowing computation to be executed as a single unit without kernel launching overheads.

methods.name: Realtime Feature Processing
methods.description: Consumes user action Kafka streams using Flink, validates action records, detects and combines duplicates, manages time discrepancies, and materializes features into Rockstore.

methods.name: Form larger batches
methods.description: Uses larger batches in the original requests directly for GPU-based inference instead of splitting requests into small batches via scatter-gather architecture.

methods.name: Hybrid cache
methods.description: Implements a cache that uses both DRAM and SSD to compensate for the loss of cache capacity.

methods.name: realtime-batch hybrid model
methods.description: A model that requires both realtime and batch user features.

methods.name: transformer encoder
methods.description: Composed of 2 transformer blocks without positional encoding, applied to the encoded sequence feature.

methods.name: Pinnability weighted cross-entropy loss
methods.description: A weighted cross-entropy loss designed for multi-label classification tasks incorporating a label weight matrix M to weight each action head's contribution and a user-dependent weight wu based on user state, location, and gender

methods.name: Negative downsampling
methods.description: Downsampling on negative samples with a fixed ratio between positive and negative samples to balance the skewed dataset

methods.name: concat early fusion
methods.description: Concatenation of candidate pin's PinSage embedding with user action features to produce sequence feature matrix

methods.name: transformer-based sequence aggregation
methods.description: Standard transformer encoder with 2 layers and 1 head without positional encoding to aggregate user action sequences

methods.name: Random Time Window Mask
methods.description: Masking technique using timestamps of user actions to prevent the rabbit hole effect and maintain diversity

evaluation_results.metric: computational complexity in terms of floating point operations
evaluation_results.value: 65 times more computationally complex compared to its predecessors
